title: The Girl Before
author: J. P. Delaney
summary: A grieving woman rents a stark, ultra-minimalist house from an enigmatic architect, on the condition that she obeys strict rules. She learns that the previous tenant died there, and that the pair share an eerie resemblance.
readIf: you like sleek psychological thrillers with a spooky house and two women's stories moving in parallel.
skipIf: you dislike narrators who withhold things, or books where the male lead is clearly suspicious from page one.

pairings.reason: Another fast domestic thriller about control and a charming man who is not what he seems.
The classic version of this story: a young woman haunted by the woman who lived in the house before her.
Another twisty thriller with a psychologist at its heart and a shocking reveal late on.
